description: Lowers blood glucose, or adds to the glucose-lowering effect of something else.
Reduces platelet aggregation, so bleeding takes longer to stop.
Slows the clotting cascade itself, as distinct from platelet effects.
Lowers blood pressure, or adds to the blood-pressure-lowering effect of something else.
Slows the heart rate or atrioventricular conduction.
Raises or lowers serum potassium, or is sensitive to potassium changes.
Increases urine output, affecting fluid and electrolyte balance.
Causes drowsiness or central nervous system depression.
Inhibits one or more cytochrome P450 enzymes, slowing clearance of their substrates.
Induces one or more cytochrome P450 enzymes, speeding clearance of their substrates.
Cleared mainly by a cytochrome P450 enzyme, so its level moves when that enzyme is altered.
Transported by P-glycoprotein, so its level moves when that transporter is altered.
Small changes in blood level separate an ineffective dose from a toxic one.
Has reported associations with liver injury.
Reported to alter thyroid hormone levels or thyroid function.
